artworks.title: Along the Thames (Sur la Tamise)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This sketch shows a side view of a man on a boat on calm water. The horizon is not clearly defined, with distant shorelines and soft hills indicating depth. The brushstrokes are delicate and mostly fine, linear etchings of varying density to imply texture and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray to show details. The simple lines and lack of color highlight the peaceful atmosphere. The water is calm with subtle reflections, and there are trees and foliage sketched in the background.

artworks.title: Lord A. Tennyson, 2nd plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This image depicts a man with a full beard and mustache looking to his right. He has deep facial lines and wears a hat casting a shadow over his face. He wears a collared shirt underneath a dark coat. The background is textured and dark.

artworks.title: Fisherman with a Hoop-net (La peche a la truble)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a low angle perspective capturing a scene dominated by natural elements. Tall trees obscure the horizon line, with a dense woodland area dimly lit. A lone figure is engaged in an activity by a water source, seen standing close and bent over, wielding a long fishing net. The style features soft, sketch-like strokes creating texture and depth, seen in the rendering of trees and grass. The overall color palette is muted with varying shades of brown, giving a warm, monochromatic effect.

artworks.title: Water's Edge by Morning Light (Au bord de l'eau (Effet du matin))
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a natural landscape from an elevated point of view, featuring a sloping terrain leading into the distance. The horizon is depicted with a shift in shading slightly above the center of the composition, marked by soft hills blending into the sky. The brushstrokes are intricate, with hatching and cross-hatching creating texture and shading. The color palette is sepia, giving a vintage feel. Large trees with detailed bark frame the view, with light and shadow emphasizing depth and tranquility.

artworks.title: Christ before Annas
artworks.description: The engraving depicts several individuals engaged in various interactions within a medieval interior setting. At the center right, a figure is seated on a throne-like chair, engaged in a legal or official proceeding. Around them, multiple people are depicted in dynamic postures, some standing, others kneeling, dressed in robes or tunics consistent with medieval fashion. The scene is bustling, with several people gesturing or pointing, indicating active discussion or conflict. In the background, there are decorative tapestries or banners with ornate patterns and an archway leading to another room filled with additional figures engaged in conversation. The setting is richly detailed with architectural elements like columns and a tiled floor.

artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man being whipped. The image shows a semi-nude figure tied to a column in the foreground, surrounded by individuals. Some of them are inflicting corporal punishment on the central figure. The drawing is detailed with precise lines, similar to woodcut printmaking techniques. In the background, there is an architectural setting with columns, arches, and steps leading to more figures in the distance. The atmosphere is tense, capturing the physicality and drama of the moment through expressions and postures.

artworks.title: Christ before Pilate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in an architectural setting. The scene includes a central seated figure and several standing figures around them in a large hall with classical columns. Some figures are entering or exiting through an arched doorway to the right. The hall has arches, columns, and a checkered floor.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures in a historical setting. The background features an architectural space with arches and windows. In the foreground, several figures are engaged in various activities. Some are conversing, while others seem involved in other actions. One figure sits on the ground near an opening with a rope in hand. The figures display detailed expressions and postures, conveying different emotions and actions. The intricate line work adds depth and texture to the composition.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a Crucifixion scene. The illustration shows a detailed composition divided into two main sections. In the foreground, the central figure sits with a crown of thorns, surrounded by various figures. The background displays a landscape with three crosses erected, two occupied. Additional figures are present, some on horseback and others standing or kneeling. The scene is rendered with intricate linework and shading, typical of early engraved religious artworks. Architecture in the background suggests a town or city with notable structures such as a steeple.

artworks.title: Saint John on Patmos
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated on a rocky landscape, writing or drawing with a quill on a piece of paper in their lap. The person has closed eyes and curly hair, wearing long robes. Nearby stands a menacing bird, a crooked tree trunk, and various rocky formations. In the background, there is a body of water with a small figure on a boat. Above, an ethereal figure of a woman holding a child is surrounded by a radiant aura.

artworks.title: Arms of Rohrbach and Holzhausen
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 9.6 × 9.4 cm (3 3/4 × 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing depicts an ornate coat of arms. It includes a central figure of a crowned helmet with elaborate scrolling leaf motifs. Flanking the helmet are two shields. The left shield features a looped object, while the right shield displays two stylized floral emblems. Intricate vine patterns fill the background, enhancing the heraldic theme. The composition is symmetrical, emphasizing the grandeur and formality of heraldic art.

artworks.title: Emperors Charles V and Ferdinand I
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated across from each other engaged in conversation. The man on the left has a beard, short curly hair, and a decorative cap. He wears ornate clothing with a fur-lined collar and a chain of office. The man on the right has short straight hair and a clean-shaven face. He wears a wide-brimmed hat with decorations and lavish clothing with a fur collar. Both men have hands on an embroidered cloth, possibly a tablecloth or cushion. They wear necklaces with medallions. The background features an arched structure embellished with cherubs and floral designs.

artworks.title: Christ Blessing the Virgin
artworks.dimensions: diameter (sheet trimmed to plate mark): 8.7 cm (3 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two central figures. One is seated, wearing a crown with fleur-de-lis, flowing garments, and holding a globe with a cross. The seated figure has long hair, a beard, and serene facial features, making a gesture. Beside them, another crowned figure kneels with long hair, wearing a draped gown, leaning towards the seated figure. The background features angelic beings, architectural elements resembling a throne and columns. Above the central figures, a dove with a nimbus and rays is enclosed in a roundel design. The intricate carving suggests movement and grace in a historical or religious context.

artworks.title: The Battle of Fornovo
artworks.artist: Master of the Battle of Fornovo
artworks.medium: engraving printed on two sheets of laid paper joined at center
artworks.description: This is a print of a battle scene. The print shows a wide landscape densely populated with armored figures engaged in combat. Some are on horseback, while others stand; some hold long lances while others have swords. In the center, there are groups of soldiers with long spears and cannons. To the left, there are trees with some people among them, some wearing hats. The left is a chaotic fight between people in armor holding long weapons and other people in hats with round shields. A river in the top third of the print roughly divides the scene; at the top, tents and encampments are seen in the background below rolling hills, with groups of soldiers standing together.

artworks.title: Fishing Scene
artworks.description: The image shows a bustling scene along a river with various figures engaged in activities like fishing and boating. Close to us, figures are depicted in detail, with one man fishing on a barrel and another standing by the water with a net. Boats with people rowing or fishing are seen further away, leading to a horizon of trees and a distant view of a village with towers. The artistic style features fine lines and hatching for texture, with a monochromatic sepia color palette. In the background, people are gathered near tents.

artworks.title: Christ as the Man of Sorrows
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in vermilion, dark green, light blue and brown; glued into the top lid of a travelling strong box
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 22.5 x 14.5 cm (8 7/8 x 5 11/16 in.)
overall (cofferet): 10 x 16 x 23.5 cm (3 15/16 x 6 5/16 x 9 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an antique box. The image features an open wooden box with a metal exterior and a painted interior on the lid. The painting on the lid depicts a central figure with two other figures on either side. The colors are primarily earthy tones, with rich reds, yellows, and blues. The wooden interior of the box shows signs of age, with the fabric lining appearing worn and discolored. The exterior of the box has a rustic metallic design with some decorative elements, indicating its historic craftsmanship.

artworks.title: Bookplate of the Abbey of Ottobeuren
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in vermilion and red on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic coat of arms. The image features a shield with a rampant lion at its center. At the top of the shield is a helmet crested with a creature that resembles an eagle with outspread wings and a crowned head. The shield is decorated with intricate leaf-like mantling. The color palette includes black and red tones. At the bottom, there is an inscription in a stylized script.

artworks.title: Deer in the Forest
artworks.description: This image shows a woodland scene viewed from a ground-level perspective, featuring trees, foliage, and deer. The intricate crosshatched etching technique creates detailed textures and the monochrome color palette highlights light and shadow contrasts. Deer are depicted in various positions throughout the scene, set in a lush forest with diverse tree species. The background shows layers of trees extending into the distance.

artworks.title: The Jester
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and exaggerated curved shapes to create an abstract composition. A central figure wearing a jester-like hat with bells rides a fantastical creature and holds drumsticks poised above drums emitting smoke-like swirls. An animal resembling a dog or feline stands next to a striped cat playing on the ground. The artwork blends elements of whimsy and fantasy in an abstract manner.

artworks.title: Coridone, Lover of Corisca
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a monochromatic sketch showing a figure moving dynamically to the right. The horizon is suggested by a line of trees and bushes. The brushstrokes are expressive and capture motion with curved lines and hatching for shading. The color palette consists of shades of brown and gray, resembling traditional ink drawings. The figure appears to be stepping toward the right with an outstretched arm, surrounded by foliage. The background fades into cloud-like formations, enhancing depth and movement.

artworks.title: Uranio and Carino
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene set in an ancient or classical city environment. The drawing depicts an urban landscape with classical architecture, including a prominent temple-like structure to the right and a large building with decorative facades and an archway to the left. The structures are rendered with detailed lines and shading. In the foreground, two robed figures are conversing. The background includes a gathering crowd.

artworks.title: Chorus of Shepherds and Priests: Montano, Mirtillo
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring figures gathered around a central figure who appears to be kneeling. Another figure is extending a hand towards the central figure. In the background, there are additional figures surrounding a structure with ornate columns and drapery. The drawing includes intricate line work and delicate shading, creating depth and texture in the architecture and figures. The scene conveys a sense of ritual in an elaborate setting.

artworks.title: Ergasto and Corisca
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an image of an encounter between two figures. The scene is set against an architectural backdrop. One figure is depicted with outstretched arms and flowing garments, in a dynamic pose. The second figure faces the first with extended arms. The background features classical architecture with columns and ornate buildings, under a sky with swirling clouds. The shading and lines in the drawing convey depth and movement, suggesting a moment of high drama or action.
